editorialNotes: Marriage, birth and adoption remain distinct. Gendered source pronouns are retained where natural; shared Bulgarian verb forms do not need artificial gender suffixes.
Gift item names are quoted after предмет to avoid inflecting runtime item names.
The three-day ceremony and fourteen-day birth timing, repeated placeholders and caret separators are preserved.

corrections: Used a natural Bulgarian confirmation question for both gift prompts.
Removed awkward repeated prepositions in the banned-player lookup error.
